doc.field: The legendary Lüchow's restaurant at 110 East 14th Street, Manhattan, catered to celebrity clientele for a century (1882–1983). A newspaper clipping filed with one of Morgan's negatives explains the reason for this particular gathering was to celebrate the recent birth of Lüchow's owner Jan Mitchell's son, David.
